NewsArticle.Title: Noble Garments
NewsArticle.Content:
Now Noble Garments may be placed in a bank or may be transferred to someone else. Be careful that your garments are not stolen. For example, you should place the garment in storage when you go anywhere that is dangerous.
It is possible to gain noble garments through being recognized by mundanes. Garments normally available at level 41 can be obtained at level 11 by exceptional talent. Ask Jean in Loures about details. Three grades of the great garments exist, each with unique graphics for each class, and each gender. The garments are normally wearable at higher levels (71, then 97 or 56 and 71 for Warriors). These versions of the garments do not offer superior armor protection. They are status symbols. They symbolize the essence of the Aisling: creativity and imagination.
Learn more about the library and [contests.](http://www.darkages.com/community/contest.html)
